phrases.english: Meanwhile the dishes had to be washed.

phrases.latin: dum pater catillōs ōllāsque lavat et avia tergit
phrases.english: while Dad washes the dishes and pots and Grandma dries
one hand washes the other (handy at the sink)

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency: p. 38, checked against the searchable text of the book on 29 October 2026.
